lines: Having restrained mental-fluctuations in cakra having attained rest; having risen as long as rests so long movement-rising indeed this.
l4.sanskrit_cite: niruddhya mānasīrvṛttīścakre viśrāntimāgataḥ vyutthāya yāvadviśrāmyettāvaccārodayo hyayam
